children: (“Inventus” or the “Company”) announces that it has granted 3,400,000 incentive stock options to certain officers, directors, employees, and consultants of Inventus Mining effective September 2, 2026. The options are exercisable at a price of $0.295 per share for a period of five years and have been issued under the Company’s 10% rolling stock option plan. The options vest one-third at each of 6, 12, and 18 months from the date of grant. All stock options are subject to the acceptance by the TSX Venture Exchange.

Inventus is a mineral exploration and development company focused on the world-class mining district of Sudbury, Ontario. We have a 100% interest in our principal assets, the Pardo Paleoplacer Gold Project and the Sudbury 2.0 Critical Mineral Project, located northeast of Sudbury. The Pardo Gold Project is the first important paleoplacer gold discovery in North America. Inventus has approximately 221 million common shares outstanding.
